preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
Each integer n in the test cases must be between 1 and 10^12.

postconditions.description: The output must be either -1 if n cannot be represented as the sum of distinct powerful numbers, or the minimum k if it can.
If n can be represented as the sum of distinct powerful numbers, the minimum k must be at least 1.
